knownDifference.area: Composer menu aria-expanded while visibly open
knownDifference.reason: Keep the correct expanded state instead of reproducing the reference accessibility defect

referenceLimitations: All assembled answers, tools, errors, model choices and history are scripted fixtures; no real model, provider error, backend tool execution or saved server conversation is verified
Stopping a tool leaves Preparing or Running instead of a canceled state
Opening history unmounts and discards attachments but preserves the typed draft; Clear also preserves the typed draft; model choice is cosmetic
With attachments but no text, Send is disabled while Enter still submits through requestSubmit
Stop clears files added during streaming while preserving the text typed during streaming
Source buttons and standalone Retry have no document/retry handler; standalone feedback and history deletion are memory-only
The docked assistant stays 360px wide in the narrow preview, clips right controls and compresses the knowledge-base page; closing unmounts its draft and model state
investigationCorrections: A diagnostic mobile bounding-box locator was incorrectly nested and was corrected before the clean final run
A hover difference after scrolling was removed by moving the pointer to the same neutral position; edge residuals are retained
Supplementary composer menu checks record false in the reference and true in ERPboost while visibly open; isolated pages avoid cross-preview menu remnants
Transient GitHub TLS/page-load timeouts interrupted the first public diagnostic run; the final public run allows 60 seconds per case while keeping the 5/15 second interaction expectations unchanged
